newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - Standby signal number one hoisted.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - Standby signal number one hoisted.

text.p: The weather will be cloudy with scattered squally showers, the Royal Observatory said.
The maximum temperature will be 29 C with fresh easterly winds, becoming strong offshore later in the day.
The number one tropical cyclone warning is in effect.
At 7 am the centre of tropical storm Willie was estimated at about 390 km southwest of Hong Kong and was forecast to be slow moving.
Temperatures in Hong Kong averaged 28 C and the relative humidity was 87 percent. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6441
